purpose: Development-only blind assessment of whether exact project title plus exact specific objective is sufficiently descriptive to explain project relevance for the 14 frozen weak-title cases.

rubric.CLEAR: Title plus specific objective identifies a concrete funded intervention, asset, system or activity sufficiently to understand the substance of the project.
rubric.PARTIAL: The combination adds meaningful domain or activity context but remains too broad to explain the funded intervention precisely.
rubric.NOT_USEFUL: The combination still does not explain the funded intervention beyond a brand, company, event, administrative label, slogan or broad programme objective.
